name: Holiday Soda
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ cup (120 ml) edible pine needles (preferably Douglas fir)
Peel from 3 clementine oranges (or a similar easy-to-peel variety such as tangerines)

steps: Wash the pine needle branch and clementines.
Remove the pine needles from the branches and peel the clementines.

Mix the pine needles and clementine peels with the sugar in a container, and let this sit in the fridge for 24 hours. The sugar will extract the liquid from the citrus peels and produce a syrupy liquid.
Boil the cinnamon sticks, cloves, and cardamom pods in the water.
Pour the warm water with boiled spices into the container with pine needles and peels.
Mix the ingredients together and strain the mixture.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

culture.text: This holiday soda differs from anything you will find in a can and is perfect for the holiday season. It derives from a Flavor Lab recipe. Make sure that you use a species of edible pine; some species are toxic.
